dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's weird... Looks like Wanmin Restaurant hasn't fired up their kitchen yet. Why does it smell so much like Boiled Fish around here...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon's fine! Seriously though, this smells pretty weird, but Paimon can't quite say what's off about it...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: ...Well, color me surprised! Perfume that smells like Boiled Fish! Xiangling, come give it a sniff! That's totally the scent, right?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hmm... Wow! It really is! Even the chili aroma is spot on! How did you even do that...

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Some unconventional spice combinations, specialized techniques for refining them... and most importantly, the assistance of a professional chef.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hehe, well, tons of people come to eat our Boiled Fish every day, so I'd recognize that smell anywhere.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: No way I'd mistake it for anything, even if a perfume bottle's the last place I'd expect to smell it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So it IS you, Emilie...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: #{NICKNAME}? Perfect timing! Come come, smell my wrist!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Emilie here just made us a perfume that smells like Boiled Fish. Isn't that just so cool?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Th—This is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mmm... Paimon's getting kinda hungry just from sniffing this...

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Hehe~ See? Always trust Director Hu! This perfume really sparks your appetite, doesn't it?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: I've got an idea, Xiangling. Spray perfume of this type on your menus. One variety for each dish.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: That way, even if customers haven't tried a dish before, they could just smell the menu and know roughly what it'll taste like.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: You're right! This way, we can stop guests from wasting food and Mora ordering something they'd end up not wanting to eat...!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Exactly, exactly! We could even make a whole "Liyue Flavor Atlas" — a big chunky book you can flip through to sample the aroma of every single dish. How's that for an idea?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Hmm, that... sounds like stuffing a whole bunch of dishes into the same cabinet. The flavors would definitely get all mixed up...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is this really... how perfume is supposed to be used...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks it sounds really fun, y'know! Just open it up and you can smell all the yummy food... But wait, won't that just make us even hungrier...?

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Food fragrance design is a fascinating field worth exploring. Besides, creations made on a whim are meant for our pleasure. We needn't answer to anyone on their account. Use them anywhere you like, whenever inspiration strikes.

response.speaker: Emilie
response.text: Besides... Hahaha, it seems like this perfume is already taking effect.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Uhh... That wasn't Paimon's tummy growling, it was {M#his}{F#hers}!

choices.text: Xiangling, let me borrow your perfume.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—You...! If you're gonna spray something on Paimon's head, at least make it something nice like Almond Tofu! Paimon won't be able to sleep if it's too spicy...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Why does Paimon smell Boiled Fish again? Seems pretty hot too, unlike the perfume from earlier...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: #Paimon, {NICKNAME}, Miss Emilie, food's ready!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Th—That was sudden!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: My goodness, never mind all that. All this brain work has left my tummy growling, too!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Oh right, Xiangling, could you make me another serving of Almond Tofu? Zhongli's queuing for some pastries on my behalf, so I'd like to bring some food back for him too.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Also, lend me the perfume, hehe... Let's see what our dear Consultant thinks when he tastes some Almond Tofu spritzed with Boiled Fish-scented perfume, hehehe...

choices.text: I'll spray it on Paimon's head when she's asleep.
I think I know where that smell is coming from...
Let's go order one right now, shall we?
